do_not_conclude: Interannual co-variability only: not causation, not a trend, not a forecast.

r1_validation.status: EXPLORATORY until reviewed by a second team member (P0-S5)
r1_validation.datasets: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV v5.12.4 T2M × NOAA GHCN-Daily (TMAX+TMIN)/2

r2_temp_precip.datasets: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV v5.12.4 T2M (DOI 10.5067/AP1B0BA5PD2K) × NASA GPM IMERG Final V07 monthly (DOI 10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07)
r2_temp_precip.variables: annual mean T2M (°C) × annual precipitation total (mm), GPM averaged over each MERRA-2 cell
r2_temp_precip.method: Theil–Sen detrend per series; Spearman rho of residuals; two-sided permutation p (9999, seed 0); BH across tested cells; robust = q < 0.05

r3_heat_drought.datasets: NOAA GHCN-Daily (not homogenized), station-years with >= 330 valid days per variable
r3_heat_drought.variables: hot_days_35 (days Tmax > 35 °C) × max_dry_spell (longest run of days < 1 mm)
r3_heat_drought.period: 2001–2025, years where both variables are complete
r3_heat_drought.method: Theil–Sen detrend per series; Spearman rho of residuals; two-sided permutation p (9999, seed 0); BH across stations with >= 15 paired years; robust = q < 0.05
